title: C91 Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tailored for classic roadsters and urban cruising, the HJC C91 Black delivers breezy open-air freedom for scenic cruising and city exploration. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1288g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~95 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: HJC C91 open face with shield.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval head shapes; may feel tight on intermediate oval heads due to fixed cheek pads.

technical_analysis: Features Premium Integrated Matrix (P.I.M. Plus) carbon and carbon-glass hybrid fabric shell structure paired with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism. The interior utilizes ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the HJC C91 Black: combining South Korea 🇰🇷 craftsmanship with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism and ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in HJC's Open Face lineup, the C91 Black brings South Korean engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The HJC C91 Black represents HJC's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~95 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the HJC C91 Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
